description: Grants the web app (served by the bundled Next server on a loopback port, i.e. a REMOTE origin for Tauri) exactly the three app commands it drives: raw-ZPL label transport and the update check/apply pair. No plugin permissions are granted to this origin and no core permission is needed to invoke app commands. Since tauri 2.11.1 remote origins are ACL-gated for custom commands too, so without this capability all three commands are denied in the real shell.
